schema.description: The seeker item_id that get_profile RETURNED this call (the live one, else the draft). A caller for whom get_profile returned no seeker item, or an error, has no profile_id: do not call this tool for them. Never send a made-up id such as 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 (test call 3995ceee did, with age 0).
